items.question: How does CodaAI work alongside agencies and marketing teams?
items.answer: CodaAI is built on the Co-Creation principle: human expertise steers, AI scales. Agencies and marketing teams bring strategic know-how, industry insight, and audience understanding – the CodaAI team translates that into a structured production process where specialized AI modules handle the repetitive, time-intensive tasks. The result: agency-quality content with machine-level efficiency. Experience that leads. AI that delivers.

items.question: What does 'orchestration by six AI experts' mean?
items.answer: In the Co-Create model, the CodaAI team handles the orchestration: human experts define strategy, tone, and quality standards – the AI executes. Six specialized AI modules each handle their area: Strategy & Planning, Content Writing, Visual Design, SEO & GEO, Video Production, and Distribution. The AI handles the repetitive, scalable work; human expertise ensures relevance, brand consistency, and creative quality. Like a conductor who knows the orchestra and leads every cue with precision.

items.question: How much can I actually save?
items.answer: A comparable agency retainer in the DACH region averages around €3,800 per month (DACH market benchmark 2026), with the SME band at €1,500–5,000. CodaAI's visibility tiers start at €1,470 per month and can be calculated in the pricing calculator instead of costing “on request”. This is possible through the Co-Creation model: human expertise for strategy and factual review, AI scale for production.

items.question: How does it work? What do I need to get started?
items.answer: You are personally guided through the entire process by the CodaAI team. In an initial conversation, our experts get to know your goals, industry, and target audience. The team then takes over strategic planning: topic ideation, editorial calendar, and publication strategy. The six AI specialists accelerate production – from SEO-optimized articles and professional graphics to videos. Co-Creation means: you bring your knowledge, we bring process, structure, and AI-powered delivery.

items.question: What makes CodaAI different from other AI writing tools?
items.answer: Other AI tools generate text – without strategy, without context, without quality control. CodaAI is a Co-Creation system: behind every project stands an expert team that strategically plans your content, orchestrates AI production, and aligns results with your brand. No other tool combines human content expertise so consistently with AI scalability – from planning all the way to publication.

items.question: Is CodaAI suitable for my industry?
items.answer: Yes – for any industry that relies on content marketing. The CodaAI team works together with you to define the right terminology, tone, and relevant topics. The AI specialists adapt accordingly, learning the specifics of your market. From tech startups to established enterprises: in the Co-Creation process, your industry knowledge is always part of the solution.

items.question: What contract terms are available?
items.answer: Six months, billed monthly — visibility in search and AI answers needs that time to become measurable; first mentions typically appear after 8 to 12 weeks in the German market. Committing to twelve months costs 10 % less. There is no automatic rollover: renewal is always an active decision.

items.question: What happens after I cancel?
items.answer: If you cancel, your subscription ends at the close of your current billing period (quarterly or annual). You retain full rights to all content created during your subscription. There are no hidden fees and no cancellation charges.

items.question: Why should I plan for at least 3–6 months?
items.answer: Content marketing is a long-term investment in your digital visibility – not a sprint. New content first needs to be crawled, indexed, and evaluated by search engines. This process alone takes 2–8 weeks depending on your site and competitive landscape, followed by further weeks during which algorithms observe engagement signals. AI models like ChatGPT or Perplexity also don't update their knowledge base daily – visibility there is built through consistent, citable content published over time. In the Co-Creation approach, this means: publishing consistently and with quality over 6–12 months builds a credible digital presence that search engines and AI systems increasingly recognize. The 3-month minimum is the starting point – sustainable visibility gains typically emerge from 6 months of consistent publication.

program.title: One programme. Three layers. One goal: getting recommended.
program.subtitle: Visibility in AI answers is largely created outside your own website. That's why our programme works on three layers — from the foundation to market leadership. The tier comparison shows what's included at each level.

groups.title: Core services — included at every tier

items.title: Digital Visibility Audit
items.text: The starting point: we document what ChatGPT and Google's AI Overview answer about your company today — using our study's methodology, delivered as your personal, black-and-white dashboard.

items.title: AI Visibility Monitoring
items.text: A monthly report on your mentions in AI answers: trends, not snapshots, honestly measured. Without measurement, there's no provable progress.

items.title: Classic SEO — including Bing
items.text: Search engine optimisation for Google and Bing. Bing is the underrated channel: ChatGPT's web search draws on the Bing index — hardly any provider optimises for it.

items.title: Technical AI accessibility
items.text: AI crawlers don't execute JavaScript — what's invisible to them can't be cited. We check and fix this: crawler access, rendering, readable text instead of PDFs.

items.title: Citable content
items.text: Content with statistics, sources and clear statements — the format AI systems demonstrably prefer to cite. Produced in our proven Co-Create model.

items.title: Content refresh & existing pages
items.text: AI systems favour up-to-date content. We keep your key pages and articles systematically fresh — dated titles, updated figures, optimised core pages.

items.title: Digital PR & brand mentions
items.text: The strongest measurable driver of AI visibility: your name on industry sites, in trade media and portals. AI recommends whoever it knows from many sources.

items.title: Review platforms
items.text: Profiles on the review and comparison platforms relevant to your industry — built and maintained. In B2B, AI answers lean heavily on exactly these sources.

items.title: Comparison & listicle placement
items.text: “Best vendors for X” articles are the dominant citation format for buying questions. We build our own comparison content on your domain and place you in third-party ones.

items.title: YouTube visibility
items.text: YouTube is among the most-cited sources in AI answers. We align your video production accordingly — indexable, with transcripts, instead of just social feeds.

items.title: Proprietary studies & data assets
items.text: The strongest citation magnet: your own numbers that nobody else has — mini-studies and industry benchmarks under your name. We prove it works with our own study.

items.title: Knowledge bases
items.text: Structured entries in knowledge bases like Wikidata, so AI systems recognise your company as a clearly defined entity — realistically assessed, not just promised.

items.title: LinkedIn thought leadership
items.text: In B2B, LinkedIn counts for more than any forum: expert articles that make your expertise visible where decision-makers read — and where AI answers increasingly read along.

items.title: Competitive monitoring
items.text: Who gets named in your buyer questions instead of you? We measure your share against named competitors in the AI recommendations — month after month.
